name: roi_xz6_inherit_xonly_tuning_patient_b500
description: ROI paired VCTR pilot with six scalar covariates, X-only-selected tuning, and patient-cluster bootstrap.
model_label: X+Z6 paired VCTR inherited-X-only-tuning patient-bootstrap pilot
notes: Weekly-report pilot only; not final manuscript inference.
The six Z columns are sex plus paired-eye mean VF values at locations 1, 22, 25, 28, and 31.
Real patients are sampled with replacement; every selected patient's visits and OD/OS pairs are retained.
S, R, h, and hbar are inherited from the prediction-selected ROI X-only model and are not X+Z6-optimal tuning.
CP features and all preprocessing transformations remain fixed.
